During

During
the period ended March 31, 2025, the Company identified an immaterial error related to foreign currency translation adjustment in its
previously issued financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2024.
The
error resulted in an understatement of general and administrative expenses and a corresponding overstatement of foreign currency translation
adjustment by approximately $ 159,263 for the year ended December 31, 2024. There was $ 159,263 increase on net loss, a ($ 0.04 ) decrease
in earnings per share, and a $ 159,263 decrease in total equity.
The
accompanying comparative 2024 financial statements have been revised to correct this error. The Company has evaluated the error in accordance
with the SEC’s Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 99 and SAB No. 108 and concluded that it was not material to its previously issued
financial statements and therefore has been corrected herein through revision.
